item.title: Yemeni army reports 661 attacks on Houthis as group advances towards Aden

item.description: Kushner reports progress towards a deal, but Moscow says it has not agreed to European participation in the next talks.

item.title: UK seeks closer ties with EU after Brexit fail
item.description: Prime Minister Andy Burnham says UK lost more than it gained after its divorce from the bloc.

item.description: The country's unresolved Oromia-Somali border dispute fuels renewed violence, displacing thousands.

item.title: Paraguay ex-president moved to military jail amid special treatment reports
item.description: Santiago Pena has been accused of corruption following the collapse of Ueno Bank earlier this month.

item.description: Donald Trump is heading to the Philippines where he’s scheduled to speak at a meeting of ASEAN leaders in Manila.

item.description: 'Preliminary monitoring' shows women and children killed, homes destroyed in West Kordofan, says Emergency Lawyers.

item.title: Manchester United’s Endless Loop
item.description: Thirteen years, eight permanent managers, almost £100 million spent on sacking and hiring — and still no hiring

item.title: London Palestine Film Festival returns for 27th year

item.description: In a joint statement, 47 aid, trade union and rights groups urged ‌the five countries to ​abandon the Rwanda plan.
